data.description:
## What
Update SKILL.md Phase G (Sub-Agent Fix Batches, Tiers 2-7) to:
1. Use SESSION_BRANCH (resolved by T1/T3 pre-Phase-F step) for bug-batch/* PR base in ci-pr mode
2. Remove the local `/dso:review` dispatch block for ci-pr sub-branches; replace with a note that `per-branch-review.yml` CI workflow is triggered automatically on the sub-branch PR
3. Confirm local mode (DEBUG_MODE=local): commit directly to session branch, no sub-branch — byte-identical to pre-epic behavior

## Files
- plugins/dso/skills/debug-everything/SKILL.md (Phase G section)

## Testing mode
GREEN — SKILL.md doc-only change; validated by behavioral test in T4

## Done when
- Phase G text uses SESSION_BRANCH for PR base in ci-pr mode
- Phase G contains no /dso:review dispatch for ci-pr sub-branches (per-branch-review.yml routing note in its place)
- Local mode section is unchanged
data.title: Update debug-everything SKILL.md Phase G: open bug-batch/* sub-branch PRs against session_branch in ci-pr mode; remove local /dso:review dispatch
